payload.posture: Read Luke 24:1–12 as one movement in Peter's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states the women report the empty tomb and remembered words; Peter runs, sees the linen cloths, and departs wondering. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Peter's story.
